title: How to Get Out of Tutorial Hell
description: Stuck in tutorial hell? Learn how to get out by turning Python tutorials into practical projects that build real skills and lasting confidence.
summary: Tutorial hell is an unfortunate reality for many newcomers to Python, and learning how to get out of it starts with understanding why it’s so easy to fall into. When you’re a beginner, finishing tutorials is addictive!
takeaways: Tutorials are most useful for teaching one specific topic, and they necessarily limit the scope of the problems you solve so you can focus on the skill you’re learning.
You keep learning new concepts, but you never practice making the decisions programmers have to make on their own.
They make learning Python approachable by giving you a clear problem, showing you the steps to solve it, and letting you know when you’re finished.
